decisions.reason: Because this 2023 substrate offer is close to the firm's core packaging business, fits its stated move into higher-value proprietary applications, and the firm is investing and growing, management would likely justify the sunk development effort and treat any limited traction so far as temporary.

Because this 2024 laser-structuring service was launched very recently with a dedicated page and strong public positioning, builds directly on the firm's processing know-how and strategic technology investments, and has had too little time to judge conclusively, management would strongly persist with it.
